description: This file defines the LinePlotAreaRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering the plot area of line charts in a PDF charting library. It inherits from ColumnLikePlotAreaRenderer and overrides the Draw method to draw lines and markers for data series using GDI+ graphics objects.

classes.name: LinePlotAreaRenderer
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering line chart plot areas within the charting library.

methods.name: LinePlotAreaRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with given parameters.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Overrides the base Draw method to render the line chart plot area, including lines and markers for each series.

methods.name: DrawMarker
methods.description: Helper method to draw markers at data point positions.
